# nomatron Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nomatron = {
      source  = "nomatronio/nomatron"
      version = "0.4.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "nomatron" {
  address = "http://localhost:4649"
  token   = var.service_account_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The Nomatron API address.
- `token` (String) The Nomatron service account token.

### Optional

- `tls_ca_cert` (String) The path to the TLS CA certificate file.
- `tls_cert` (String) The path to the TLS certificate file.
- `tls_key` (String) The path to the TLS key file.
